d:
25 year old Kaylee Sim was a kind and pretty girl who always tries to make others feel good. Unfortunately, she had inadvertently made someone feel very bad. Her male colleague Billy had a crush on her and his girlfriend was enraged by this. She paid a thug to "teach Kaylee a lesson."

One day, Kaylee was taking the elevator back to her apartment and when she stepped out of the elevator, she was surprised to see a masked man holding a wooden stick, seemingly waiting for her, she tried to run but was knocked unconscious by the man, who was the thug paid to "teach her a lesson".

The man dragged her to a corner of the basement where he had earlier left an empty fridge. He stuffed her limp body inside, thinking that she would learn a lesson when she wakes up alert on.

5 hours later, 30 year old Ricky who stayed at the same apartment accidentally took the elevator to the basement. He saw a fridge just lying there and decided to salvage it for useful parts to sell. He happily pushed it back to his apartment (It felt unnaturally heavy).

when he opened it, he was shocked to discover the lifeless body of a woman inside. He had seen her around before and she had even said hi to him a few times. He always felt a bit aroused by her beauty and sexy body. But now she looks to be in distress. She seems pale and is not breathing. He must save her!

Ricky immediately started CPR and mouth to mouth on her. He got increasingly aroused as he did so.

Ricky realized the woman is beyond help. He decided that this must be heaven's gift to him and he is not going to waste her.

After he had impregnated the woman's dead womb and mouth, he stuffed her back into the fridge and wheeled her back into the basement of the apartment.

4 days later, the janitor ( who was off sick for the last few days) finally found her body. By then, Kaylee had ripened wonderfully. The cops and CSi arrived shortly after but no meaningful trace of DNA could be found on her.

By some miracle, the master mortician Dr Anders wa able to restore much of Kaylee's looks at her funeral. More than a few of her visiting friends and relatives felt aroused when they see her body.

THE END
